tagline: Your Claude Code chats, across accounts.
hero:
Switch accounts.
Pick up where you left off.
heroDescription: One click synchronizes all your projects and prepares Claude for your next account.
closeDescription: Quits the application and waits for it to close.
syncDescription: Updates chats and verifies files and images.
reopenDescription: Then sign out and sign in to your other account.
previewHint: Preview: chat counts and file details are examples.
usageHint: Use after your Claude tasks have finished.
readyDescription: All projects across your accounts will be synchronized.
progressHint: Your accounts are being prepared. Please keep this window open.
syncedClaudeClosed: Chats synchronized. Claude is still closed.
syncComplete: Sync complete. You can now switch accounts in Claude.
syncWithoutAudit: Sync complete. Files have not been checked yet.
syncLegacyAudit: Sync complete. Diagnostics are from an earlier version.
syncPreserved: Sync complete. Preserved copies of missing files are available.
verificationSummary: {{artifacts}} artifact references · {{files}} local files · {{images}} local images · {{embedded}} images in chat histories
settingsDescription: Claude and its chat folders are detected automatically. Choose another location if your installation uses a custom folder.
claudeApplicationDescription: The Claude Desktop application to reopen after synchronization.
chatHistoriesDescription: Choose your .claude/projects folder if it is in a different location.
previewSettings: Folder and application choices are disabled in preview mode.
verifiedAvailable: The verified local content is available.
noAudit: Artifacts and images have not been checked yet.
legacyAudit: These diagnostics were saved by an earlier version. Its file counters do not distinguish temporary references from delivered files.
historicalExplanation: These earlier references and failed sending attempts do not represent missing delivered files.
imagesExplanation: Images may be local files or embedded in chat histories. Verification does not establish whether they were generated by Claude.
backupExplanation: View files opens recovered copies and image previews. The latest backup includes a detailed asset-manifest.json report.

historical.missingReferences_one: {{count}} reference to a file, document, or code that is no longer available
historical.missingReferences_other: {{count}} references to files, documents, or code that are no longer available
historical.failedSends_one: {{count}} earlier failed attempt to send a file
historical.failedSends_other: {{count}} earlier failed attempts to send files

errors.UNKNOWN: Something interrupted this action. View details for more information.
errors.SYNC_BUSY: Another synchronization is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND: Claude could not be found. Choose its application in Settings, then try again.
errors.NO_CHATS: No Claude Code chats were found. Create a Code chat in Claude Desktop, or check the data folder in Settings.
errors.CATALOG_INVALID: Some chat data could not be read. View details before trying again.
errors.CLOSE_FAILED: Claude is still open. Finish your tasks and close Claude, then try again.
errors.OPEN_FAILED: Claude did not reopen. Use Open Claude to try again, or open it yourself.
errors.PROCESS_CHECK_FAILED: The app could not confirm whether Claude has closed. View details before trying again.
errors.SYNC_FAILED: Synchronization could not finish. View details before trying again.
errors.PATH_INVALID: This folder cannot be used. Choose a regular local folder in Settings.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: This application supports Windows, macOS and Linux.
errors.PYTHON_NOT_FOUND: The synchronization component is unavailable. Reinstall the app, or check the setup instructions if running from source.
errors.BACKEND_FAILED: The synchronization component could not start or finish. View details before trying again.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: The synchronization summary could not be saved. Your latest backup is still available.
errors.SETTINGS_FAILED: Your preference could not be saved. View details for more information.
errors.PATH_OPEN_FAILED: This folder could not be opened. Check that the latest backup is still available.
errors.INSPECT_FAILED: The app could not read the Claude installation details. Check your folders in Settings, then try again.
errors.CLAUDE_RUNNING: Claude is still running. Finish active Claude Code sessions and quit Claude Desktop completely, then try again.

notices.SAVE_FAILED: Chats were synchronized, but the summary could not be saved. Your latest backup is still available.
notices.SETTINGS_FAILED: This preference could not be saved. It may need to be selected again next time.
notices.UNKNOWN: This action needs attention. Check the settings and try again.

remoteExplanation_other: {{count}} remote links were found. Their availability has not been checked.
preservedExplanation_one: {{count}} original delivered file is missing from its recorded path. {{preservedSummary}}
preservedExplanation_other: {{count}} original delivered files are missing from their recorded paths. {{preservedSummary}}
preservedCopies_one: {{count}} preserved copy is available through View files.
preservedCopies_other: {{count}} preserved copies are available through View files.
previewsExplanation_one: {{count}} image preview was recovered from file-reading history. It does not replace the complete original file.
remoteExplanation_one: {{count}} remote link was found. Its availability has not been checked.
